description: Felix 2026-11-11: Aimparency committed but never pushed, so commits made on a hosted server stayed there (the remote-follower then reported 'diverged'). The commit dialog gets an 'and push' option, and the header button shows unpushed commits (↑N) and opens a push-only dialog when nothing is left to commit. Pushes the whole branch to its upstream, never prompting for credentials.

status.comment: git status reports ahead (commits not on @{upstream}, null without one); pushToUpstream runs git push with GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 and a 120 s timeout, and reports a rejected push as 'pull them first'; git.push mutation (admin, writable .bowman only). CommitModal: 'and push (+N earlier)' checkbox, on by default when an upstream exists; with nothing to commit it becomes 'Push N commits'; when a push fails after a commit, the commit stays and a toast says so. Header button shows ↑N and is enabled when only unpushed commits remain. Evidence: git-working-tree test on a real bare remote (no upstream, ahead 1 → pushed, rejection after the remote moved on) 4/4; CommitModal spec 3/3; backend tsc and vue-tsc --build clean; pnpm check 24/25 before the spec fix (only the frontend typecheck failed, now green). Not clicked live.
